summary: Wipro Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing its acquisition of select customer contracts of Alpha Net Consulting LLC for a purchase consideration of up to US$70.8 million, including a deferred earnout, subject to customary adjustments. The consideration is cash, and no regulatory approvals are required. The transaction is expected to close by June 30, 2026. The business acquisition will augment Wipro's AI-powered and consulting-led application services capabilities. The board of Wipro approved the transaction, though no specific advisor is named. No premium or stake percentage is stated as it is an asset acquisition. Watch for closing conditions and any adjustments to consideration.
